Zach, Anthony, and Farzan at the CSE Holiday party Nadia performing during the CSE Holiday Skits Theory Group on a hike to Three Sisters Falls Russell doing improv at the Wrestling with Complexity Workshop Overview The theory group does research in many different areas of theoretical computer science, such as algorithms, computational complexity, cryptography, coding theory, learning theory, graph theory, logic, and combinatorics. Many of our faculty are affiliated with other groups as well, such as the security group or the machine learning group. We also have strong connections with the mathematics department , Halicioglu Data Science Institute (HDSI), and EnCORE Institute .
